The SAN-X Sumikko Gurashi Friction Ballpoint Pen Slim 3 Color 0.5Mm Pink is a delightful and practical writing instrument perfect for everyday use. Featuring three vibrant ink colors in one slim pen, it allows you to switch effortlessly between colors without the need for multiple pens. This pen is designed to bring a touch of fun and creativity to your writing experience, inspired by the beloved Sumikko Gurashi characters.

Ideal for students, professionals, and stationery enthusiasts, this friction ballpoint pen offers smooth and precise writing with its 0.5mm tip. The friction ink technology enables you to erase mistakes cleanly, making it perfect for note-taking, journaling, and planning. Its compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry in your bag or pencil case, ensuring you have multiple colors handy whenever you need them.

Details

• Product Material: Plastic

Features

  • Three ink colors (typically black, blue, and red) in one slim pen for convenience and versatility

How to use

To use the SAN-X Sumikko Gurashi Friction Ballpoint Pen, simply slide or click the selector to choose your desired ink color. Write smoothly on paper with the fine 0.5mm tip. If you make a mistake, gently rub the friction area of the ink with the eraser tip to erase without damaging the paper. Store the pen capped or with the ink selector retracted to prevent drying out.

Care instructions

Keep the pen capped or retracted when not in use to maintain ink quality and prevent drying. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures. Avoid dropping the pen or exposing it to harsh chemicals. Clean the pen tip gently with a soft cloth if ink buildup occurs.
